% Pattern: number/counter. \let\claim\claimx with \let\endclaim\endclaimx
% makes claim the environment claimx, which steps the counter claimcnt within
% the theorem, so the claim in theorem 1 is 1.1. Seen in the gold pilot
% (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1
% want claim-1 statement/claim 1.1
% want claim-2 statement/claim 1.2
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{claim}[theorem]{Claim}
\newcounter{claimcnt}[theorem]
\renewcommand{\theclaimcnt}{\thetheorem.\arabic{claimcnt}}
\newtheorem{claimx}[claimcnt]{Claim}
\AtBeginDocument{%
  \let\claim\claimx
  \let\endclaim\endclaimx
}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem} Every finite space is compact. \end{theorem}
\begin{claim} Every point is closed. \end{claim}
\begin{claim} Every subset is finite. \end{claim}
\begin{theorem} Every closed set is compact. \end{theorem}
\end{document}
